record.title: PedWest pandemic facility closure persisting beyond national entry ban
record.scope: PedWest local pedestrian facility within San Ysidro
record.direction: Closure at facility; endpoint specifically northbound into United States.
record.exceptions: PedEast remained available. PedWest briefly processed Ukrainian refugees in 2022; ordinary northbound service resumed 9 January 2023 at 06:00–14:00, without full southbound or 24-hour restoration.
record.enforcement: Order or reported operations as specifically documented.
record.relationship: Local facility phase nested within US pandemic restrictions AM001; lasted beyond national November 2021 nonessential-entry change, not an independent national closure.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Pandemic-related closure and reduced border traffic.
record.uncertainty: Exact April 2020 onset day remains unverified. Contemporary 2023 reporting confirms ordinary northbound reopening, but a brief 2022 Ukrainian-refugee use interrupts any claim that the facility was closed to all persons throughout.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Month-precision onset retained; first verified return of northbound passage January 9 2023, limited hours.
